items.title: The Mango Tree
parts:
The mango tree is tall and wide,
With birds that sing on every side.

Its leaves are green, its fruit is gold,
It gives us shade when sun is bold.

items.title: Little Snail
parts:
Little snail, so slow, so small,
Carries home, and that is all.

Slide along the garden wall,
You never hurry, not at all.
